evidence_rules: Pre-1970 ratings use only the documented early presence of tennis and stay low-confidence.
The organised-play expansion is gated to the 1970s, TSÍ foundation to 1987 and the Kópavogur indoor-hall step to 1995.
Current 2026 indoor instruction/coaching is current-only and is not backcast.
Small-population access and institutional continuity are not treated as world-leading playing quality.
No rankings or title outcomes are calibration targets.
